historical_references.reference: Safee ibn Abi Talib was the cousin and trusted companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He was the protector and guardian of Ali, the fourth Caliph of Islam, during his childhood. Safee was known for his bravery and loyalty towards Ali and his family. He was often targeted by the enemies of Ali and was thus given the title 'As-Saeed' which means 'the fortunate' or 'the lucky'. This title was given due to his frequent escape from death in various battles and conflicts.

Safee ibn Shayba was a renowned scholar, Hadith narrator, and companion of Imam Malik ibn Anas, the founder of the Maliki School of Fiqh. He was born in Medina and studied under various scholars including Imam Malik. He is known for his extensive collection of Hadith and his contributions to the Maliki School. He was also a prominent figure during the Umayyad and Abbasid Caliphates.
